title: When Yixian fell
basis: The left pursuit force's own account: it attacked on the 19th, climbed in over the south gate after dark and finished clearing the town at 00:30.

records.says: 3月18日…第4師在嶧縣附近與日軍機械化部隊激戰，嶧縣當日晚間失陷
日没後人梯ヲ作リ城門上部ノ破壊孔ヨリ突入城門ヲ開キテ城内ニ進入掃蕩シ…二十日午前零時三十分掃蕩ヲ完了シ縣城ヲ確保ス

title: When the Japanese took Zaozhuang
reading: 20 March, by a company of the left pursuit force; not shown
basis: The Japanese report sends the company after Yixian fell; parties along the Lincheng–Zaozhuang branch may have been there from the 18th.
